welcome:
Hello and thanks for the invitation! :tada:

I’m **{{ .name }}**, your new Discord assistant dedicated to the game **{{ .game.Name }}** {{ .gameLogo }}!
My goal? To offer you practical and fun tools to spice up your gaming experience. :fire:
Here are some of my superpowers: 
* :sparkles: Manage the directory of artisans and aligned members in your guild

Curious to see everything I can do? Type {{ .help }} and explore all my commands! :smirk:

<@{{ .owner }}>, as the administrator of **{{ .guild }}**, you can access advanced features to configure my services.
With `/{{ .config }}`, set up:
* :globe_with_meridians: The main game server for your guild
* :bell: Notifications for tweets, RSS feeds from the game

Sounds epic, right? Can’t wait to team up with you to make this server even more fun and useful! :smile:

detailed.get:
displays the book of aligned players on your Discord server
   - The `city` field is optional and corresponds to the city to which players have pledged allegiance. If not specified, the directory is displayed without considering this filter. *__Example__:Bonta*
 - The `order` field is optional and corresponds to the order joined by players. If not specified, the directory is displayed without considering this filter. *__Example__:Spirit*
 - The `server` field is optional and corresponds to the desired game server. If not specified, the game server used is the one defined for the Discord guild (see `config`). *__Example__:Boune*
detailed.set:
records your alignment in the book, independently of the Discord server; this recording cannot be done for others.
   - The `city` field is mandatory and corresponds to the city to which players have pledged allegiance. *__Example__:Bonta*
 - The `order` field is mandatory and corresponds to the order joined by players. *__Example__:Spirit*
 - The `level` field is mandatory and corresponds to the alignment level between 0 and 60, with 0 indicating removal from the directory. *__Example__:60*
 - The `server` field is optional and corresponds to the desired game server. If not specified, the game server used is the one defined for the Discord guild (see `config`). *__Example__:Boune*

help.overview: permits to configure the game server, RSS feeds or tweets automatic sendings

detailed.get: displays my current configuration for this Discord server
detailed.rss:
enables/disables the automatic sending of [RSS feeds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RSS)
  - The `feed` field is mandatory and corresponds to a type of RSS feed. *__Example__:Devblog*
  - The `enabled` field is mandatory and corresponds to the activation or deactivation of this feature. *__Example__:True*
  - The `channel` field is optional and corresponds to the channel where messages will be posted. If not specified, the current channel is used. *__Example__:#general*
  - The language used is the user's language. If it is not supported, the default language *{{ .defaultLocale }}* will be used.
detailed.server:
links the Discord server to a game server
  - The `server` field is mandatory and corresponds to a game server. Once specified, it will be the default value for certain commands such as `align` or `job`. *__Example__:Boune*
  - The `channel` field is optional and is used to link a game server to a specific channel. This link takes priority over the link to the Discord server. *__Example__:#general*
detailed.twitter:
enables/disables the automatic sending of tweets from the official Twitter account of the game
  - The `twitter` field is mandatory and corresponds to a Twitter creator name. *__Example__:DofusRETRO_EN*
  - The `enabled` field is mandatory and corresponds to the activation or deactivation of this feature. *__Example__:True*
  - The `channel` field is optional and corresponds to the channel where messages will be posted. If not specified, the current channel is used. *__Example__:#general*
